values.name: attr_values_are_sorted_and_typed
values.source: { devShells.x86_64-linux.default = pkgs.mkShell { packages = builtins.attrValues { first = pkgs.fd; second = pkgs.ripgrep; }; }; }
values.nix_expression: let pkgs = { fd = "fd"; ripgrep = "ripgrep"; }; in { packages = builtins.attrValues { first = pkgs.fd; second = pkgs.ripgrep; }; }

values.name: filtered_package_lists_preserve_literal_values
values.source: let names = [ pkgs.fd pkgs.ripgrep ]; in { devShells.x86_64-linux.default = pkgs.mkShell { packages = builtins.filter (name: name != "fd") names; }; }
values.nix_expression: let names = [ "fd" "ripgrep" ]; in { packages = builtins.filter (name: name != "fd") names; }

values.name: conditional_package_values_match_the_oracle
values.source: { devShells.x86_64-linux.default = pkgs.mkShell { packages = if true then [ pkgs.fd ] else [ pkgs.ripgrep ]; }; }

values.name: overlay_and_unknown_field_projection
values.source: let overlay = final: prev: { custom = prev.fd; }; in { devShells.x86_64-linux.default = (import pkgs { overlays = [ overlay ]; }).mkShell { packages = [ (import pkgs { overlays = [ overlay ]; }).custom ]; inputsFrom = []; }; }
values.nix_expression: let pkgs = { fd = "fd"; }; overlay = final: prev: { custom = prev.fd; }; in { packages = [ (overlay pkgs pkgs).custom ]; inputsFrom = []; }

values.name: named_devshell_projection
values.nix_expression: let pkgs = { ripgrep = "ripgrep"; }; in { packages = [ pkgs.ripgrep ]; }

authority_derivations.name: fixed_output_fetcher_context
authority_derivations.source: builtins.derivationStrict { name = "fetched"; system = "x86_64-linux"; builder = "/bin/sh"; args = [ "-c" "echo $src > $out" ]; src = builtins.fetchurl { url = "file:./source.txt"; sha256 = "03e21237b264daa4b7dc6bc5ada1c24ba9d646a29720c31d1c0ab09cc5b03867"; name = "source.txt"; }; }
authority_derivations.nix_expression: let source = builtins.toFile "source.txt" "fixed-output\n"; fetched = builtins.fetchurl { url = builtins.unsafeDiscardStringContext "file://${source}"; sha256 = "03e21237b264daa4b7dc6bc5ada1c24ba9d646a29720c31d1c0ab09cc5b03867"; name = "source.txt"; }; in { fetched = fetched; input_sources = builtins.attrNames (builtins.getContext fetched); }

derivations.name: multi_output_package_identities
derivations.nix_expression: let d = builtins.derivationStrict { name = "many"; system = "x86_64-linux"; builder = "/bin/sh"; outputs = [ "out" "dev" "doc" ]; }; in { drvPath = d.drvPath; out = d.out; dev = d.dev; doc = d.doc; }
